defects.what: Black letterbox bars fill the top and bottom quarters; the helicopter is a small band in the middle of the frame.
The big white building has a sign of Chinese/Japanese-style glyphs and a red seal on its facade, and the street of tiled houses reads as a Japanese town.
Close-up key fobs carry pseudo-letters and stamped glyphs (one grey fob reads like 'C2L WHC').
The plaque Indio holds in the foreground shows lines of fake engraved script.
The sarimanok's head is a flat human-like face with a mask patch, odd next to the bird body.
A small sign with letters ('WV...') on the wall to the right of the door.
Fragments of letters on the yellow tank at the top right.
Pseudo-letters on the side of the yellow drill.
The broken padlock face carries a glyph-like emblem.
